data.title: 若叶睦 · 换好的一根弦
data.description: 换好琴弦后，她轻拨了几下，低头听音准。确认没有问题，睦才把调音器收回琴盒。
data.promptProse: Seated on a folding chair in a rehearsal studio, Mutsumi rests her electric guitar across her knees while trimming a newly strung nickel guitar string with wire cutters. An open velvet-lined case, string packages, and a clip-on digital tuner sit on the floor beside a stack of amplifiers.
data.animaCaption: She trims the excess string wire with a small click, lightly plucking the newly replaced string to test its resonance.
